ctx.x: Oh yeah because there are some transcriptions that I did of other players that are out there as well. Yes actually, there’s a book that was out a while ago and the person who did the transcriptions, he’s actually a fine saxophonist from Michigan, John Wojciehowski. He actually sent me, I think there are like ten solos in this book, to edit them, to make sure that they were correct.
How do you know they’re correct?
